candidates.description: This vector represents demonstrative determiners and pronouns across multiple languages.
This vector represents concepts related to celebrations, festivities, and celebratory events.
This feature activates for terms representing close family members, romantic partners, and domestic relations.
This vector represents religious faiths, denominations, and related figures.
This feature vector represents cultural heritage, established traditions, and customary practices.
This vector activates on possessive determiners and pronouns across multiple languages.
This vector represents words related to days and times of day across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents common German auxiliary and modal verbs across various tenses and conjugations.
This feature vector represents common French copular and auxiliary verbs, particularly forms of the verb "être" (to be).
This feature vector represents variations of the word "other" across multiple languages.
